name: thicket-cli
description: Official command-line interface for Thicket (thickethq.com): projects, to-dos, messages, docs and files, boards, chat, search, reports, timesheets, notifications, cheers, and OAuth connections, from your terminal or through AI agents.

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
